behavior: agent_run_trace.v1 renders a bounded tail of session events and a run card. It does not join authoritative continuity, claim, quality-outcome, or token-impact records by exact identity and does not expose integrity-scoped proof stages or explicit source gaps.
buyer_baseline: A caller can inspect the session event tail, but cannot obtain one integrity-checked receipt of what context arrived, what changed, what was verified, what outcome was reported, and what the system learned.
